en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Barqy, from Ja’far Bin Basheer, from Musa Bin Bakr Al Wasity who said,

‘I asked Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> about the man who borrows and performs Hajj, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If he has wealth left behind, if the event of death were to occur with him, so it would be paid off from him, so there is no problem’.
en.sarwar: 6. Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa has narrated from al-Barqiy from Ja’far ibn Bashir from Musa ibn Bakr al-Wasitiy who has said the following: “

I once asked abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a man who borrows for al-Hajj. He (the Imam) said, ‘If he leaves behind an asset that can pay off his debt in case something happens to him, then it is not harmful.’”
